results.title: The Bank on Broadway - ZoomInfo.com
results.snippet: Broadway Bank is a multi-billion dollar financial services organization with locations throughout south central Texas. Founded in 1941, Broadway has evolved from a small neighborhood bank into the largest independently-owned bank headquartered in San Antonio. The b ank specializes in business banking, private banking, and wealth management.

results.title: Broadway Bank reports record revenue, rules out sale or merger
results.snippet: Broadway Bank holds $5.6 billion in total assets currently. Broadway Bank interim CEO and president Harvey Hartenstine said 2025 will deliver the highest revenue in the bank's 84-year history. With this banner year in the works, Hartenstine, a 45-year banking veteran, also addressed whether the privately-owned bank has plans to sell or merge.
